basis: Severe congenital myopathy and defining urethral malformation: hypospadias in 2/2. Respiratory insufficiency reflects muscle weakness without established intrinsic lung damage.

decisions.renal: primary: hypospadias is a urethral malformation, reported in 2/2, forming part of the defining genital abnormalities; urethra belongs to the renal axis.

basis: C1q-associated lupus causes cutaneous disease in ~90% and nephritis in ~30-40%; inflammatory arthritis occurs in ~20%, below the threshold.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: inflammatory arthritis occurs in approximately 20% of C1q-associated lupus, below the 30% threshold; typical SLE arthritis frequencies should not be substituted.

basis: Generalized fat loss, metabolic dysfunction and characteristic myopathy define CGL4; abnormal muscle histology 5/5. Hepatic steatosis 1/3 supports hepatic involvement; atrial fibrillation 1/5 excluded.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: characteristic congenital myopathy is a defining feature of CGL4, supported by abnormal skeletal muscle histology in 5/5 and weakness in 3/5.

basis: Glycosylation disorder with defining severe NDD and seizures in 2/2; contractures 2/2 and optic atrophy 1/2. Respiratory insufficiency lacks evidence of intrinsic lung damage.

decisions.neurologic: primary: severe neurodevelopmental impairment and seizures in 2/2, with structural CNS abnormalities, constitute the defining clinical presentation.

basis: NDD and agammaglobulinemia define disease; optic atrophy 2/4 and central hypothyroidism 1/1 assessed support involvement. Endocrine frequency rests on one assessed patient.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: central hypothyroidism indicates endocrine loss of function in 1/1 assessed; use the supplied HPO denominator, with uncertainty from the single assessment.

basis: Congenital skeletal myopathy; cleft palate in 2/4 supports gastrointestinal involvement. Respiratory failure 2/2 reflects ventilatory muscle weakness without demonstrated intrinsic lung damage.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory failure and reduced vital capacity reflect respiratory muscle dysfunction; recurrent pneumonia does not establish direct pulmonary damage by the myopathy.

basis: Inherited cerebral and vascular amyloid disease; hearing impairment and cataracts each occur in 30-79%. Progressive hearing loss is prioritized over cataracts under the four-axis cap.

decisions.ocular: none under cap: cataracts occur in 30-79%, but the three defining axes and progressive hearing loss take priority.
decisions.otologic: involved: progressive hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%; its potentially permanent severity supports retaining it under the four-axis cap.

basis: HHV8-associated inflammatory lymphoproliferation; pulmonary interstitial involvement occurs in approximately 30-50%. Hepatomegaly alone does not demonstrate hepatic damage.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: pulmonary interstitial inflammation/infiltration occurs in roughly 30-50% of HHV8-associated MCD and is explicitly described in the supplied definition.

basis: Inherited susceptibility to future CLL, without established leukemia or another current organ disorder; a target of future cancer risk does not establish organ involvement.

decisions.haematologic: none: this concept denotes inherited susceptibility rather than blood-cell disease; adding the organ solely for future leukemia risk violates the later-risk exclusion.

basis: Ross River virus infection causes inflammatory polyarthritis in approximately 80-90% of symptomatic patients, often prolonged. Transient rash does not qualify for dermatologic involvement.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: inflammatory polyarthritis affects approximately 80-90% of symptomatic patients; the supplied concept is defined by viral infection, with arthritis a common organ manifestation.
